text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-ACB 2 Inch Acrylic Ball Shower Door Handles

These 2" diameter acrylic ball glass shower door handles are hand made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest clear acrylic available. The crystal clear acrylic is manufacture with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading.

The retro-modern design is really stunning. Our pictures do not do them justice. The are available with Polished Chrome or Satin Nickel mounting.

Specifications for First Impressions SD-ACB-2 Acrylic Ball Shower Door Pull

  • Ball Diameter 2"
  • Rosette Diameter 1-3/16"
  • Rosette Thickness 1/4"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Pull Handle Material: Crystal Clear Acrylic
  • Rosette Material: Solid Brass
  • Rosette Finish: Polished Chrome

Packaged with 2 shower door handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
